item.blacksouls.abandoned_trash.lore.1: A block of trash with no apparent use.
item.blacksouls.abandoned_trash.lore.2: But no matter how useless something seems, someone will always find a use for it.
item.blacksouls.bills_bento.lore.2: The basket is stuffed with eggs and all kinds of fruit.
item.blacksouls.blackwell_blood_vial.lor: I distinguish between different people, but never treat them unequally. -Dr. Blackwell
item.blacksouls.blood_vial.lore.2: Blood loss leads to death. Madmen cannot understand this, and often let their blood flow freely.
item.blacksouls.candy.lore.1: Delicious candy that can captivate a girl.
item.blacksouls.candy.lore.2: Collecting them may bring something good.
item.blacksouls.christmas_chicken.lore: Mr. Chicken's life ended in a cold land, and then he was delivered to us.
item.blacksouls.goat_meat.lore: Ah, my beloved children... Where have you vanished to? -Mother Goat
item.blacksouls.goddess_blood.lore.1: Removes abnormal statuses and fully restores HP and MP.
item.blacksouls.goddess_blood.lore.2: A goddess fell from the heavens and died; the spray of her blood nourished the earth.
item.blacksouls.golden_mead.lore.2: A winged noblewoman is rather fond of this mead.
item.blacksouls.helanrith_wine.lore.1: Action Count +100%%. Can be used infinitely.
item.blacksouls.helanrith_wine.lore.2: Fine wine produced in the trade city of Helanrith.
item.blacksouls.herb_bottle.lore.2: Can be used indefinitely after touching a bonfire.
item.blacksouls.herb_bottle.lore.3: The fragrance of herbs is just enough to mask the stench that pervades this kingdom.
item.blacksouls.herb_bottle_m.lore.2: Can be used indefinitely after touching a bonfire.
item.blacksouls.herb_bottle_m.lore.3: It is filled with mana, turbid beyond measure, like the Carroll River polluted by factory waste.
item.blacksouls.maidens_fragrance.lore.1: Fully restores HP and removes Hollowed status.
item.blacksouls.maidens_fragrance.lore.2: Where is my beloved Alice? I must find her quickly.
item.blacksouls.match_medicine.lore.1: It restores 3000 HP and MP, but...
item.blacksouls.match_medicine.lore.2: What wonderful matches♪ Please buy some matches♪ -The Little Match Girl
item.blacksouls.mermaid_song.lore2: The song of a beautiful mermaid whose throat was cut out by the Sea Witch.
item.blacksouls.mysterious_meat.lore: ...Are you really going to eat it?
item.blacksouls.pigeon_egg.lore.2: Though girls hate eating raw eggs, snakes love them most.
item.blacksouls.pregnant_cake_meat.lore: A piece from scattered chunks of flesh.
item.blacksouls.pure_water.lore2: The water is polluted, so it cannot be drunk.
item.blacksouls.queen_egg_tart.lore: Do not tell that person. Keep it absolutely secret. It is a secret.
item.blacksouls.rabbit_watch.lore.1: Reduces all skill cooldowns by 10 seconds when used.
item.blacksouls.rabbit_watch.lore.2: The White Rabbit bound by rules will never
item.blacksouls.retrieval_poker.lore.2: Play poker? I am no child anymore! -Lorina, Queen of Hearts
item.blacksouls.roasted_cheese.lore: Why does Ludwig Street smell so strongly of cheese! -Pato the Mouse
item.blacksouls.sedative.lore.2: When you glimpse something utterly terrifying in an instant, this may become necessary.
item.blacksouls.snake_god_blood.lore.1: For a short time after drinking it, you will not become unable to fight.
item.blacksouls.snake_god_blood.lore.2: Blood is the very expression of madness. Humans and beasts alike are equally intoxicated by it.
item.blacksouls.turtle_soup.lore.2: No meat or fish is needed. Everyone hopes for delicious soup!
item.blacksouls.snake_bone_return.lore.1: Returns you to the last bonfire you rested at.
item.blacksouls.snake_bone_return.lore.2: Surely the Snake God will become your sanctuary. -Bill the Lizard
Returns you to the last bonfire you rested at.
Remember the bonfire where you once warmed yourself with the girl.
item.blacksouls.black_ash.lore.1: Consumes all souls and returns to the Library Dream.
item.blacksouls.black_ash.lore.2: No matter how many times, you can be reborn and continue experiencing this story.
item.blacksouls.hemostatic_cloth.lore.2: It is common to be killed before you can stop the bleeding, so this may not mean much.
item.blacksouls.invisible_pepper.lore.1: Sprinkle it on yourself to conceal your form.
item.blacksouls.invisible_pepper.lore.2: Duchess or child alike—let a storm of sneezes blow through pepper hell!
item.blacksouls.antidote_herb.lore.2: Someone once said it tastes better as tempura than eaten raw.
Use in battle to put a single enemy to sleep.
Please help protect fairies, now an endangered species. -Fairy Protection Committee
item.blacksouls.orange_marmalade.lore.1: Inflicts Severe Poison on the enemy.
item.blacksouls.orange_marmalade.lore.2: Sing a song of sixpence, a pocket full of rye. -Mother Goose
item.blacksouls.candle_ember.lore.2: No matter what light shines, darkness will always exist.
item.blacksouls.throwing_knife.lore.2: Damage scales with the user's Speed.
item.blacksouls.scalpel.lore.1: Throw at an enemy to deal 10 fixed damage and inflict Bleeding.
item.blacksouls.scalpel.lore.2: Through surgery that split the brain and implanted stars, they overcame death.
item.blacksouls.charcoal_pine_resin.lore: Grants the user Fire attribute for a time.
Especially effective against beasts, writhing trees, and creatures that fear fire.
item.blacksouls.gold_pine_resin.lore.1: Grants the user Thunder attribute for a time.
item.blacksouls.gold_pine_resin.lore.2: Especially effective against aquatic creatures, birds, and creatures that fear lightning.
item.blacksouls.dark_pine_resin.lore.1: Grants the user Dark attribute for a time.
item.blacksouls.dark_pine_resin.lore.2: Especially effective against clerics, magical beings, and enemies that fear darkness.
item.blacksouls.ice_pine_resin.lore.1: Grants the user Ice attribute for a time.
item.blacksouls.ice_pine_resin.lore.2: Especially effective against fire-dwelling creatures, dragons, and beings that fear ice.
item.blacksouls.star_water.lore.1: Drinking it deals 90%% HP damage, but briefly prevents incapacitation.
item.blacksouls.star_water.lore.2: Drifters flow into the doorless miniature garden. Outsiders seem to be among them.
item.blacksouls.muddy_fish.lore.1: Raises one ally's Magic Defense for a time.
item.blacksouls.muddy_fish.lore.2: The fish's belly is swollen, and its cloudy eyes are staring at you.
Raises one ally's Magic Power for a time.
If you gave this to your beloved girl, what kind of expression would she make?
item.blacksouls.iron_scrap_snack.lore.1: Raises one ally's Defense for a time.
item.blacksouls.iron_scrap_snack.lore.2: Hansel and Gretel would surely put it in their mouths without hesitation.
item.blacksouls.carpenter_nail.lore.1: Raises one ally's Attack for a short time.
item.blacksouls.carpenter_nail.lore.2: The carpenter, full of patriotism, gradually emerged from madness and regained his senses.
item.blacksouls.cursing_flower.lore.1: Lowers one enemy's Defense and Magic Defense. Does not consume a turn.
item.blacksouls.cursing_flower.lore.2: The talkative flower was beheaded, yet began muttering words of resentment once more.
item.blacksouls.dev_time_ring.lore.1: While equipped, skill cooldowns are disabled.
item.blacksouls.dev_time_ring.lore.2: An illicit item born only for testing.
item.blacksouls.dev_time_ring.lore.3: The pocket watch no longer needs to chase after time.
trinkets.slot.blacksouls.head: Head
item.blacksouls.vorpal_blade.lore.1: A weapon forged from the head-hunting rabbit's blade.
item.blacksouls.murderers_shotgun.lore1: Changes Break skills into Gunfire Break. Speed -5%%.
item.blacksouls.murderers_shotgun.lore2: §oA high-powered shotgun used by Jack the Ripper.
tooltip.blacksouls.murderers_shotgun.des: Changes Break skills into Gunfire Break. Speed -5%%.
tooltip.blacksouls.murderers_shotgun.lor: A high-powered shotgun used by Jack the Ripper.
item.blacksouls.andor_sword.lore.1: A sword handed down from a ruined kingdom.
skill.blacksouls.aura_blade_radiant.name: Aura Blade / Radiant Blade
item.blacksouls.knight_sword.lore.1: A sword widely used among the knights of Andor.
item.blacksouls.drake_sword.lore.1: A weapon fashioned from the tail of Hail Caesar, the drake.
Only one acknowledged as a hero may wield this blade. Vorpal's bloodline lives on.
item.blacksouls.knight_king_sword.lore.1: A glorious sword wielded by the knight among knights.
item.blacksouls.thiefs_dagger.lore.1: A lowly weapon used by thieves and brigands.
item.blacksouls.great_thiefs_dagger.lore: A weapon for one capable of stealing everything in the world.
item.blacksouls.great_sword.lore.1: A great sword with tremendous weight and attack power.
item.blacksouls.giant_sword.lore.1: A great sword capable of destroying everything in its path.
item.blacksouls.broad_spear.lore.1: A spear with blades on both sides of its broad, sword-shaped tip.
item.blacksouls.gungnir.lore.1: A spear that guides its bearer to victory and can pierce even gods.
item.blacksouls.gungnir.lore.2: [Hit Rate +100%%/Counter Rate +100%%/Stun Rate +10%%/Armor Pierce/Gale Sixfold Thrust]
skill.blacksouls.bs2_skill_sweep.name: Sweep
message.blacksouls.skill.berserk_locked: You can only use normal attacks while berserk!
A great sword inhabited by the smoke-maddened power of the Bandersnatch.
item.blacksouls.vorpal_sword.lore.1: Long ago, a hero used this sword to behead an evil dragon.
item.blacksouls.club.lore.1: A rough wooden club with considerable killing power.
item.blacksouls.king_club.lore.1: A gigantic log that can hardly be called a club. Its destructive power is peerless.
skill.blacksouls.bs2_skill_struggle.name: Struggle
item.blacksouls.upgrade_material.lore: A material used to upgrade weapons.
item.blacksouls.mysterious_shard.lore: A stone used to upgrade special weapons.
item.blacksouls.violent_cloak.lore.2: A bloodstained coat worn by the violent.
item.blacksouls.frenzied_king_cloak.lore: The coat of Andor's king, whose nation was swallowed by darkness.
item.blacksouls.angel_raiment.lore.2: An angel descended in search of the fallen goddess,
item.blacksouls.angel_raiment.lore.3: and fell to the earth along with her.
item.blacksouls.leather_armor.lore.2: Armor made from the hide of a magical beast,
item.blacksouls.leather_armor.lore.3: wearing it alone stirs violent impulses within.
The coat of the little match girl,
filled with a nostalgic, warm, and tender feeling.
item.blacksouls.gentleman_coat.lore.2: A garment befitting a man of knowledge and refinement.
item.blacksouls.prostitute_dress.lore.2: Clothing worn by a woman of the night.
item.blacksouls.prostitute_dress.lore.3: Step into the realm of women's clothing, and you may be despised even more.
item.blacksouls.plate_armor.lore.2: Armor with little more than a metal plate fixed to the front.
item.blacksouls.milton_armor.lore.2: For the temple knights blessed by Milton, the Goat God,
item.blacksouls.milton_armor.lore.3: this is a suit of glorious armor.
item.blacksouls.milton_helmet.lore.2: For the temple knights blessed by Milton, the Goat God,
item.blacksouls.deep_sea_knight_helmet.l: this gear resists the crushing burden of the deep sea.
item.blacksouls.deep_sea_knight_armor.lo: this armor resists the crushing burden of the deep sea.
item.blacksouls.crew_headscarf.lore.2: So long as survival is possible,
item.blacksouls.crew_headscarf.lore.3: even the flesh of one's comrades will suffice.
The oni warrior born from the peach
brought ruin upon the old couple.
item.blacksouls.oni_warrior_armor.lore.2: The oni warrior born from the peach
item.blacksouls.oni_warrior_armor.lore.3: brought ruin upon the old couple.
item.blacksouls.sailor_suit.lore.2: Many sailors crossed the seas in pursuit of freedom,
item.blacksouls.sailor_suit.lore.3: only to be invited into the deep.
item.blacksouls.snake_dress.lore.2: A dress with serpents writhing inside.
item.blacksouls.snake_dress.lore.3: The name 'Francis Liddell' is embroidered upon it.
tooltip.blacksouls.snake_dress.self_pois: Enter Severe Poison state at start of battle
item.blacksouls.disciplinarian_robe.lore: A certain disciplinarian, whose soul was stolen by the goddess of the end,
wore this black ceremonial robe as a coat.
item.blacksouls.ominous_clothes.lore.2: A coat smeared with vast amounts of pitch-black blood.
item.blacksouls.ominous_clothes.lore.3: Merely draping it over oneself invites bottomless evil to seep in.
tooltip.blacksouls.guardian_angel.desc: After being cast out of paradise, beautiful angels were born in a hospital turned graveyard.
message.blacksouls.chrono_clock.guardian: Chrono's pocket watch turned back the hands of death.
item.blacksouls.butetsu_armor.lore.2: Forged by the military empire of Longaia,
item.blacksouls.butetsu_armor.lore.3: this armor excels in both offense and defense.
item.blacksouls.hunters_attire.lore.2: Black hunting garb worn by hunters
item.blacksouls.hunters_attire.lore.3: to ward off the blood splashed by magical beasts.
item.blacksouls.armor_of_the_sun.lore.2: Armor worn by a zealot in search of the sun.
item.blacksouls.armor_of_the_sun.lore.3: Yet in this land, perhaps the sun could never be seen at all.
item.blacksouls.cleric_vestment.lore.2: Clothing worn by clerics who set out to spread the teachings of God.
item.blacksouls.magician_coat.lore.2: A coat given as a keepsake to graduates of the Elheim Academy of Magic.
item.blacksouls.knight_armor.lore.2: Steel armor commonly worn by knights.
item.blacksouls.warrior_armor.lore.2: Armor for warriors who yearn for battle.
item.blacksouls.shadow_attire.lore.2: Garb worn by assassins and thieves to melt into the shadows.
item.blacksouls.babel_tower_armor.lore.2: Armor of the tower knights. In their arrogance, they would crush the small beneath their feet.
item.blacksouls.phantom_thief_cloak.lore: A thin cloak once worn by Arsene Lupin.
An outfit restricted for being far too provocative. Try giving it to that rabbit woman.
item.blacksouls.mystery_of_night_sky.lor: A mystery itself, woven beyond the far side of the night sky.
It looks rather comical, doesn't it?
item.blacksouls.cleric_circlet.lore.2: It recreates the shape of an angel's halo, symbolizing revelation granted to clerics.
item.blacksouls.magician_hat.lore.2: A hat given as a keepsake to students of the Elheim Academy of Magic upon graduation.
item.blacksouls.thief_mask.lore.2: A mask used to slip into shadows, silence sound, and conceal one's face.
item.blacksouls.knight_helmet.lore.2: A steel helm widely used among knights.
item.blacksouls.viking_helmet.lore.2: A horned helmet that serves as the symbol of a brute.
item.blacksouls.white_hairband.lore.2: The possession of a maid who served you, longed for you, and wagered her life for you.
Helm of the tower knights. In their arrogance, they would crush the small beneath their feet.
item.blacksouls.ninja_headband.lore.2: Protective gear made by fitting a metal plate into a headband.
item.blacksouls.mysterious_hat.lore.2: A strange hat that fills the wearer's head with happiness.
item.blacksouls.hatter_hat.lore.2: 10/6 means ten shillings and sixpence, YO! -Hatter
item.blacksouls.sky_knight_hat.lore.2: The hat of a knight who soars freely through the blue sky.
item.blacksouls.igor_mask.lore.2: A mask used by the hideous Igor to cover his face.
item.blacksouls.rabbit_ears.lore.2: Decorative ears that led countless trends in Wonderland.
item.blacksouls.lawyer_mask.lore.3: The pitiful barrister had his head cut off.
item.blacksouls.ring_cat.desc: Prevents the wearer from dying to fall damage.
item.blacksouls.ring_silver_serpent.desc: Doubles the souls gained from battle.
item.blacksouls.ring_lief.desc: §a§oBetraying you is just how I show my love! §a§oDon't take it to heart, okay? Ehehe♡
item.blacksouls.ring_resurrector.desc: Nullifies critical hits and instant death.

Increases MP.

Increases Magic Defense.

lore.blacksouls.soul_red:
Increases Attack.
A red fruit, shaped by the wrath of a skeletal general, took the form of a soul.
item.blacksouls.soul_four_leaf_clover.lo: Searching for a four-leaf clover is much like searching for the White Rabbit.
lore.blacksouls.soul_four_leaf_clover:
Increases Luck.
Searching for a four-leaf clover is much like searching for the White Rabbit. -Alice

lore.blacksouls.soul_green:
Increases HP.

lore.blacksouls.soul_blue:
Increases Defense.
A blue fruit, shaped by a puppy's tears, took the form of a soul.
item.blacksouls.soul_black.lore.1: Raises all attributes and reduces SEN.
item.blacksouls.soul_black.lore.2: Even if your flesh decays, your soul will never fade.
Greatly raises all attributes, but reduces SEN.
This country is overflowing with black souls! Wonderful!
item.blacksouls.soul_outsider.lore.1: Greatly raises all attributes, but increases SEN.
item.blacksouls.soul_outsider.lore.2: I wish to separate you from the black soul.
lore.blacksouls.soul_fading: Use to gain a small number of souls.
lore.blacksouls.soul_skull_beast: Because of the evil dragon's curse, the hero lost his former shape and became a white beast that devours carrion.
item.blacksouls.soul_knight_of_hearts: Soul of the Knight of Hearts
lore.blacksouls.soul_knight_of_hearts: Though once a knight who pursued love and beauty, he contracted syphilis and became a magical beast.
item.blacksouls.soul_knight_of_spades: Soul of the Knight of Spades
lore.blacksouls.soul_knight_of_spades: Though once an honest knight, he was betrayed by the one he loved and became a magical beast.
item.blacksouls.soul_knight_of_clubs: Soul of the Knight of Clubs
lore.blacksouls.soul_knight_of_clubs: Though once a knight proud of his monstrous strength, he was drugged with muscle relaxants and became a magical beast.
lore.blacksouls.soul_boredom: The ugly Agugagi was abandoned. To kill his boredom, he began tormenting the weak.
lore.blacksouls.soul_pregnant_woman: It seems that most children born of close kin die young.
lore.blacksouls.soul_old_knight: Old William had grown old indeed. In a fit of terrible rage, he hacked his son to pieces.
lore.blacksouls.soul_bell_caller: And then the laughter kept bursting forth. Then came one ominous 'Boo--'.
lore.blacksouls.soul_beast_pelt: A very foolish fellow followed an expert's instructions, skinned the beaver, and coupled with it.
lore.blacksouls.soul_great_eagle: Edith Liddell, the third daughter, dreams of her prince.
lore.blacksouls.soul_jack: He murdered countless prostitutes and called it justice. Without doubt, he was a true madman.
lore.blacksouls.soul_dorm_head: A mere mathematics teacher fell in love with my daughter? How foolish.
lore.blacksouls.soul_narcissist: How doth the little crocodile improve his shining tail.
lore.blacksouls.soul_shining_star: Twinkle, twinkle, little bat, How I wonder what you at!
lore.blacksouls.soul_giant_house: A living building constructed by the architect of Wonderland, the Carpenter himself.
lore.blacksouls.soul_slave_emperor: He was little more than a clown, a fool who could not even recognize his own child's face.
lore.blacksouls.soul_slave_queen: She devoted everything in her life to her beloved daughter, Mary Ann.
lore.blacksouls.soul_torture_queen: A torture device haunted by the cruel queen's resentment, forever seeking the hateful fairy who murdered her.
lore.blacksouls.soul_bandersnatch: This is she: the shadow of violence lurking beneath perfect innocence.
lore.blacksouls.soul_jubjub: This is she: the two-sided shadow maddened by love and hate.
lore.blacksouls.soul_jabberwock: This is she: the shadow of possessiveness hidden beneath false motherhood.
lore.blacksouls.soul_divine_fish: A kin of the ruler of water, it spawned countless fry in the deep sea.
item.blacksouls.soul_deep_sea_knight: Soul of the Deep Sea Knight
lore.blacksouls.soul_deep_sea_knight: Something soft and slender pierced into the brain. Thus, he was reborn as a faithful knight.
item.blacksouls.soul_evil_dragon_hunter: Soul of the Evil Dragon Hunter
lore.blacksouls.soul_evil_dragon_hunter: Even after the passage of countless years, Vorpal's blood was still inherited.
item.blacksouls.soul_appointed_wet_nurse: Soul of the Appointed Wet Nurses
lore.blacksouls.soul_appointed_wet_nurse: If we may contribute to your proper treatment, we shall gladly offer our flesh and blood.
lore.blacksouls.soul_florence: Even unstained, innocent hands are worthless if they cannot save anyone.
item.blacksouls.soul_winter_bell_wind: Soul of the Winter Bell Wind
lore.blacksouls.soul_winter_bell_wind: A kin of the ruler of wind, wandering the world of the winter solstice while slaughtering sacrifices.
lore.blacksouls.soul_white_unicorn: Even after exile, she still believed that she and the White Lion were bound together forever.
lore.blacksouls.soul_white_lion: To rule by strength is the way of survival. To her, the weak are merely sacrifices offered to the strong.
lore.blacksouls.book_rascal.1: An arrogant boy found a raccoon's nest and dug it open. What emerged from within
lore.blacksouls.book_rascal.2: was no raccoon, but a cruel and merciless magical beast thirty meters long.
item.blacksouls.book_fox_and_grapes: Fairy Tale [The Fox and the Grapes]
lore.blacksouls.book_fox_and_grapes.1: The fruit on that tree looks so sour it must surely taste awful.
lore.blacksouls.book_fox_and_grapes.2: When harvest season comes, I shall watch the eater grimace in agony. Until then, I will guard it.
lore.blacksouls.book_ugly_duckling.1: The ugly thing lost its family, and so it hurled itself again and again into battle.
lore.blacksouls.book_ugly_duckling.2: Perhaps what it desired was not conflict, but eternal rest.
lore.blacksouls.book_high_jumper.1: 'Shall we see who can jump the highest?'
lore.blacksouls.book_high_jumper.2: The flea, the grasshopper, and the toy frog, poisoned by drugs, flew into the sky.
item.blacksouls.book_wolf_and_goats: Fairy Tale [The Wolf and the X Little Goats]
lore.blacksouls.book_wolf_and_goats.1: Chomp! The wicked wolf devoured every last goat.
lore.blacksouls.book_wolf_and_goats.2: But when it was too full to move, the goats multiplied inside its belly and escaped unharmed.
lore.blacksouls.book_hansel_and_gretel.1: The siblings' parents were terribly cruel. They never showed even a trace of love.
lore.blacksouls.book_hansel_and_gretel.2: Unable to bear abuse and abandonment, the two eventually murdered their parents.
lore.blacksouls.book_sinbad.1: Taking tales of his own valor as the foundation of himself, even abandoning the family who begged him to stop,
lore.blacksouls.book_sinbad.2: he yearned for adventure that much. Perhaps it resembled an abnormal thirst for discovery.
lore.blacksouls.book_bremen_musicians.1: The thieves met with terrible luck. Hearing the performance, they were blown clean away.
lore.blacksouls.book_bremen_musicians.2: Growing ever more confident, the band vowed to make their name ring throughout the world.
lore.blacksouls.book_iron_hans.1: A weapon of war sleeping beneath the earth awakened once more and emerged into dazzling sunlight.
lore.blacksouls.book_iron_hans.2: This weapon named Hans is the perfect embodiment of mankind's aggressive nature.
lore.blacksouls.book_dog_of_flanders.1: The old dog forgot that it had already devoured its beloved master,
lore.blacksouls.book_dog_of_flanders.2: and wandered in search of boys resembling Nello, inviting each one into its stomach.
lore.blacksouls.book_little_prince.1: It is said that the kindhearted prince wished to make the rose, his only friend, shine brighter,
lore.blacksouls.book_little_prince.2: so he became a meteor and traveled the night sky, trying to exterminate the roses of other planets.
lore.blacksouls.book_armored_knight.1: Meow, meow, we are knights. All my companions are gone, meow.
lore.blacksouls.book_armored_knight.2: But I'm not lonely at all, meow. My armor is still with me, meow.
item.blacksouls.book_donkey_ears_king: Fairy Tale [The King with Donkey Ears]
lore.blacksouls.book_donkey_ears_king.1: The king who executed all his people invited donkeys like himself to replace his subjects.
lore.blacksouls.book_donkey_ears_king.2: Thus the kingdom of donkeys was finally founded, though it perished before it could prosper.
lore.blacksouls.book_peter_pan.1: The eternal boy had his heart broken. What was he to do if he could not even convey his love?
item.blacksouls.book_monkey_and_crab: Fairy Tale [The Monkey and the Crab]
lore.blacksouls.book_monkey_and_crab.1: The cunning monkey stole the persimmon and murdered the mother crab.
lore.blacksouls.book_monkey_and_crab.2: Before long, a baby was born from the mother crab's corpse and cried for revenge.
lore.blacksouls.book_wizard_of_oz.1: The house swept up by the tornado fell back to earth.
lore.blacksouls.book_wizard_of_oz.2: Inside remained only ruined scraps and wreckage.
lore.blacksouls.book_match_girl.1: On a freezing winter night, the poor little match girl was trampled by a crowded street.
lore.blacksouls.book_match_girl.2: Cursing the unreasonable world, she set fire to homes to warm her body and soul.
lore.blacksouls.book_golden_goose.1: What would happen if one cut open the belly of the goose that laid golden eggs?
lore.blacksouls.book_golden_goose.2: Gold mixed with blood! Gold! Gold! The farmer laughed in utter madness.
lore.blacksouls.book_greedy_dog.1: The ugly dog reflected on the water's surface sneered and said:
lore.blacksouls.book_greedy_dog.2: 'Greed never loses. Use those fangs to plunder everything clean!'
lore.blacksouls.book_pull_turnip.1: 'Pull harder, pull harder'--the turnip dragged in the old man, the old woman, the granddaughter, the dog, the cat, the mouse,
lore.blacksouls.book_pull_turnip.2: the heroine, the king, and every citizen, becoming one enormous mass.
lore.blacksouls.book_kachi_kachi_yama.1: This world is all deception and betrayal, killing and being killed, revenge birthing new revenge.
lore.blacksouls.book_kachi_kachi_yama.2: Let it all burn away. The raccoon understood this as it sank into the water with its mud boat.
item.blacksouls.book_inaba_black_rabbit: Fairy Tale [The Black Rabbit of Inaba]
Father prayed to a god, only to be used by that god in the most miserable way.
I will never walk the same path as my father.
lore.blacksouls.book_robin_hood.1: His beauty captured all, men and women alike, drawing countless lovers to him.
lore.blacksouls.book_robin_hood.2: The life of the man called Striding Robin ended at the hands of a woman maddened by jealousy.
lore.blacksouls.book_bluebeard.1: My ideal wife--no matter how I violate, murder, or dissect her, I cannot find her.
lore.blacksouls.book_bluebeard.2: What I desire is golden hair... azure eyes... white skin beloved by God...
lore.blacksouls.book_daddy_long_legs.1: His endless silence and outstretched arms
lore.blacksouls.book_daddy_long_legs.2: made us feel both fear and comfort...
item.blacksouls.book_boy_who_cried_wolf: Fairy Tale [The Boy Who Cried Wolf]
The boy sold as a male prostitute developed a mental illness and caused the 'wolf is coming' uproar.
The owner did not believe the boy's lies--not until he saw the corpse on the bed.
lore.blacksouls.book_winnie_the_pooh.1: We will never forget that you BULLIED us, Christopher Robin.
lore.blacksouls.book_winnie_the_pooh.2: EVEN when you become an adult, you still cannot escape.
lore.blacksouls.book_pinocchio.1: The body was disassembled, and the soul was unreasonably sewn into a doll.
lore.blacksouls.book_pinocchio.2: Trace that memory back, and hatred for that selfish god comes naturally.
lore.blacksouls.book_nightingale.1: The little bird sang with a beautiful voice♪ Royalty and nobles showered it with praise♪
lore.blacksouls.book_nightingale.2: But once a glass bird was copied, she was discarded. Her song could reach no one anymore.
lore.blacksouls.book_snow_queen.1: Words and pictures cannot express my love. In this sealed white world, there are only the two of us.
lore.blacksouls.book_snow_queen.2: No one may interfere. From now on, stay by my side forever. I will never let you leave alive again.
lore.blacksouls.book_snow_maiden.1: -An illustration of Gerda riding on a crow.

S-so please, don't be sad anymore...
Even if I spin around three times, I will not forget you...

dialogue.blacksouls.noden.first_1:
Pleased to meet you, Mr. %s.
I am §cNoden§f. I serve as the administrator of this library.
dialogue.blacksouls.noden.first_2:
Lord %s. Please gather souls as your sustenance.
Wonderland, once a paradise where birds and beasts lived happily, is now stained by madness and violence.
dialogue.blacksouls.noden.first_3:
Lord %s, you are our important guest.
If there is anything you desire, please do not hesitate to ask me, Noden.
dialogue.blacksouls.noden.second_1:
Lord %s.
In this land exist §cfour nightmares§f from the gloomy depths.
dialogue.blacksouls.noden.second_2:
§cBandersnatch of Raging Smoke
§eJubjub the Mad Bird
§7Corpse Dragon Jabberwock§f
dialogue.blacksouls.noden.second_3:
And...
the tyrant of Frissel, the Red Castle, §4the Queen of Hearts
dialogue.blacksouls.noden.second_4:
If you encounter any one of them...
Lord %s, take great care that they do not steal your soul.
dialogue.blacksouls.noden.later_1:
Welcome back, Lord %s.
Do you need something?
gui.blacksouls.levelup.dialog.welcome:
Then, Lord %s, please take my hand.
I shall offer a prayer to your soul.
gui.blacksouls.dialogue.exit_message: Please take care out there, Lord %s.
gui.blacksouls.dialogue.option.make_cloc: Ask her to make a clock
gui.blacksouls.levelup.dialog.confirm: Souls have taken root within Lord %s's body.
gui.blacksouls.dialogue.covenant.first_1: You wish to form a covenant with me...?
gui.blacksouls.dialogue.covenant.first_2:
Hehe, of course.
I, Noden, shall pray for you from the shadows.
gui.blacksouls.dialogue.covenant.second_:
There is no limit to the number of covenants.
However, if the other party is §ckilled§f or §craped§f, the bond will be severed and the covenant will be discarded, so please be careful.

However, my soul is bound here,
so it does not matter what Lord %s does to me...
gui.blacksouls.dialogue.covenant.third_1:
Lord %s...?
Are you curious about my ears...?
Um... you may try touching them, if you wish...?
gui.blacksouls.dialogue.covenant.fourth_:
My homeland is surrounded by the sea,
and the sea breeze is truly so pleasant.

Lord %s.
Someday, I will let you see me in a swimsuit, hehe.
gui.blacksouls.dialogue.covenant.fifth_2: Please let me stay by your side from now on...
gui.blacksouls.dialogue.seek_service_2: Alright... Please let me serve you...❤

gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.name: Chrono
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.line.2: I am the god of time, the spirit and administrator dwelling within that pocket watch. My name is Chronos.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.line.3: So, my new master. What do you expect of me? And what do you wish to become?
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.line.4.br: Hah... What sin did I commit in a past life to be bound to such an ambitionless, boring mortal? You'd better not get blown up by a creeper while farming. I don't want to waste my power rewinding time to save you.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.choice.br: I want to rule over everything, even transcend the laws of this blocky world.
Nothing much, really. Just want to farm, mine, and slack off every day.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.idle.1: You've come again. I am observing this world, and incidentally observing whether you've made any progress.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.idle.2: The pocket watch is still ticking, and time is still passing. Only you are standing still, staring blankly. Truly reassuringly stable.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.idle.3: If you have nothing urgent, I suggest you look toward the distance. It's more meaningful than staring at me with a silly grin.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.idle.4: Are you that bored? Why do you keep staring at me?
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.idle.5: A human's daily life is truly wondrous. Always wasting time, yet always complaining there isn't enough.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.idle.6: I am not your memo pad. But if you've forgotten your goal again, it wouldn't be the first time.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.interacti: Iron ingot. The first cog of civilization has finally begun to turn. Well done.
Gold ingot. Shiny, soft, and prone to making humans grin foolishly.
Diamond? A master of mine two hundred years ago seemed to fancy this sort of thing.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.prompt: Enter what you want to say to Chrono
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.ai_hint: Ask whatever you wish. I will listen, but I do not guarantee I will indulge you.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.config_hi: Enter an OpenAI-compatible API Key, Base URL, and model name. They will only be saved to your local client configuration.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.config_sa: Configuration saved. Now, don't waste your time on entering the wrong address.
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.waiting: The maiden is praying... Please wait. PS: Wait time depends on model context length / provider latency, meow...
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.empty: I heard nothing at all. Don't tell me even your questions have been eaten by time?
gui.blacksouls.chrono_dialogue.error: The request failed. This is not my doing. It is most likely your API key, the address, or just your luck.

Even if the roots spread to the depths of hell, the flowers will still bloom.

"I have always believed that no matter how many sins demons have committed, at the end of atonement, there should be forgiveness."
"For if it is not so... only sorrow will continue."
"As long as humans or demons are born, hatred will persist."
"Hatred for the wrongs the other has committed is understandable."
"But hatred for the very existence of their life... is unmistakably wrong."
